shortDescription: Use or describe a NetFoundry Network

options.name: credentials
options.description: Path to API account credentials JSON file relative to playbook directory. Overrides default environment variables and file paths described in https://developer.netfoundry.io/guides/authentication/

options.name: inventory
options.description: optionally, perform expensive operations to describe all resources

options.name: network
options.description: The name or UUID of the Network to use or describe.

options.name: network_group
options.description: optional name or UUID of the Network Group to use. This is not typically necessary because there is normally only one Group.

options.name: organization
options.description: optional name or UUID of the identity Organization to use. This is not typically necessary because there is normally only one Organization, that of the caller's identity.

options.name: session
options.description: session object from netfoundry_info.session may be used to continue using an existing session instead of creating a new session with `credentials`, `organization`, `network_group`
